tools.name: mmap_declare
tools.description: Grow the Mellos map: set the title and diagram kind, add layer bands, lanes and groups (labeled subsystems within ONE band — declare them when a single band grows crowded, roughly five or more nodes in that band; a group must be a strict subset of its band, and a map spread thin across many bands needs none), add nodes, add dependency edges. Declare the whole ghost design up front, then grow it as understanding deepens. Edges must point strictly downward (a node may only use nodes on lower layers); the batch is all-or-nothing.

page.description: page (parallel map) this call targets; omit for the default page. One effort = one page: start a NEW effort on its own page named after the effort, so concurrent sessions never write over each other and the pane can switch between pages.

title.description: map title, e.g. the feature being built

kind.description: diagram kind. dev (default) = the live progress ledger with status skins. The rest are documentation diagrams rendered neutrally: architecture (layered components; also fits call graphs and module dependencies), dataflow (source→transform→sink, stages as layers), behavior-tree (root on top, leaves at the bottom; also fits mind maps and WBS), sequence (classic call/return: rank = time step with rank 0 = EARLIEST, drawn top-down; declare lanes as participants and make every call AND every return its own event node in the acting participant's lane, edges labeled with the message). State machines are unsupported: cycles cannot enter a Mellos map.

label.description: column name, e.g. a sequence participant

lanes.description: vertical columns crossing all bands; declaration order = left-to-right

rank.description: 0 = bottom / most primitive; must be unique

label.description: subsystem name shown at the far zoom

layer.description: band this group clusters; members must live on the same band
id of the band this node lives in

detail.description: design notes shown in the pane detail panel: responsibility, contract, key decisions

group.description: same-band group this node belongs to

kind.description: node kind rendered as a glyph prefix. Known: selector | sequence | parallel | decorator | condition | action (behavior trees); source | transform | sink (dataflow); service | db | queue | ui (architecture). Unknown kinds are kept and shown in the detail panel.

submap.description: page slug of this node's child map — the pane badges the node ⊞ and double-click dives in. Declare the child page separately. Create a sub-map only when the node's internals genuinely deserve their own picture; most nodes need none.

from.description: the node that USES the other (must live on a higher layer)

to.description: the node being used (must live on a strictly lower layer)

tools.name: mmap_update
tools.description: Update node status/label/evidence. Set in-progress when starting a node (the pane spins), done with evidence when its verification passes, regressed with evidence when a done node breaks. The map is a ledger: report honestly, it never blocks you.

page.description: page (parallel map) this call targets; omit for the default page. One effort = one page: start a NEW effort on its own page named after the effort, so concurrent sessions never write over each other and the pane can switch between pages.

status.description: planned = ghost on the map; in-progress = spinner; done = verified; regressed = was done, now broken

evidence.description: for done: how it was verified; for regressed: what broke

detail.description: design notes shown in the pane detail panel: responsibility, contract, key decisions

group.description: join this same-band group; null leaves the current group

anyOf.description: node kind rendered as a glyph prefix. Known: selector | sequence | parallel | decorator | condition | action (behavior trees); source | transform | sink (dataflow); service | db | queue | ui (architecture). Unknown kinds are kept and shown in the detail panel.

kind.description: set the node kind; null clears it

lane.description: join this lane; null leaves the current lane

submap.description: link a child map page; null unlinks it

tools.name: mmap_remove
tools.description: Remove edges, nodes, groups and empty layer bands (in that order, all-or-nothing). Removing a node also removes every edge touching it; removing a group merely ungroups its members. Use when the ghost design turns out wrong — the map is a hypothesis, revising it is honest work.

page.description: page (parallel map) this call targets; omit for the default page. One effort = one page: start a NEW effort on its own page named after the effort, so concurrent sessions never write over each other and the pane can switch between pages.

from.description: the node that USES the other (must live on a higher layer)

to.description: the node being used (must live on a strictly lower layer)

groups.description: groups to remove; members stay, merely ungrouped

lanes.description: lanes to remove; members stay, merely off-lane

layers.description: bands to remove; must be empty of nodes and groups

tools.name: mmap_setup
tools.description: Get or set this project's mapping policy — WHEN the assistant opens a Mellos map. Call with no arguments to read it. If it reports "not set", ask the USER to choose (never pick for them): always = map every structured task — workflows, designs, architecture, technical dependencies; complex = map only medium or complex tasks — several modules, a new subsystem, roughly an hour or more; on-request = map only when the user explicitly asks. Then call again with their choice to persist it. The policy guides you; it never blocks the tools, and an explicit user request for a map always wins.

policy.description: the user's choice to persist; omit to read the current policy

tools.name: mmap_view
tools.description: Render the current Mellos map as monochrome text — the same picture the split-pane watcher shows live. Use it to check the map state or to show it inline in conversation.

page.description: page (parallel map) this call targets; omit for the default page. One effort = one page: start a NEW effort on its own page named after the effort, so concurrent sessions never write over each other and the pane can switch between pages.

zoom.description: zoom ladder: 1 = detail (notes unfold), 0 = standard (default), -1..-3 = scaled down, -4 = overview glyphs
